images.title: Lift up and lift down
images.purpose: Show that the lift has a plus to go up and a minus to go down.
images.composition: One tall lift shaft centred, with one arrow up on its right and one arrow down on its right, and wide white space around.
images.exact_structure: One tall rectangular lift shaft in grey #6B7280 outline, containing one lift car (a small square) filled teal #0072B2 in its middle. To the right of the shaft, one teal arrow pointing up with a plus sign beside it, and below it one amber #E69F00 arrow pointing down with a minus sign beside it, both arrows the same length. Exactly 1 shaft, 1 car, 2 arrows.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
any extra floor, dot, arrow or row beyond the counts stated
unequal floor rows or unequal arrow lengths
images.takeaway: Plus takes the lift up and minus takes it down.
images.description: A tall grey lift shaft with a teal car in the middle, a teal up arrow marked plus and an amber down arrow marked minus beside it.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to point at the lift and say which sign moves it up and which moves it down.

image_decisions.why: The lift with its two directions is one simple picture idea.
